contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANT[IVS N C] ; R/ PROVIDEN-[TIAE...]

A 4th-century Roman copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, possibly Constantius II as Caesar, 'PROVIDENTIAE [AVGG]' type, unknown mint, (324-330 AD). Reece Period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate, draped right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANT[IVS N C]. Reverse description:Camp gateway with two towers; star above. Reverse inscription: PROVIDEN-[TIAE...]. Diameter: 18.50 mm;…
